name: @cesium/next
description: Proof of concept for a WebGPU-native CesiumJS 2.0 engine.

scripts.build:lib: vite build --config vite.lib.config.ts && tsc -p tsconfig.lib.json && tsc -p tsconfig.lib.widgets.json && node scripts/checkDeclarations.mjs --only engineering,measure,widgets dist-lib/types/proj/index.d.ts dist-lib/types/measure/index.d.ts dist-lib/types/widgets/index.d.ts
scripts.handbook: node scripts/handbookData.mjs && tsc -p handbook && vite build --config handbook/vite.config.ts
scripts.hitld:setup: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && claude plugin marketplace add arobison/human-in-the-lead#v0.1.0-rc.1 --scope project && claude plugin install human-in-the-lead@human-in-the-lead --scope project && hitld install --ref v0.1.0-rc.1 --repo arobison/human-in-the-lead
